_meta.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash + Gemini Omni Flash launch (May 19 2026)
_meta.context: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Omni Flash on May 19 2026. 3.5 Flash is the new default in Gemini app + AI Mode in Search, marketed as 'frontier intelligence at exceptional speed' at <half the cost of competing frontier models. Outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on most coding/agentic benchmarks. Gemini Omni Flash is a multimodal video+audio generation model deployed via Gemini App / YouTube / Google Flow — no benchmark scores published yet (model card explicitly defers benchmarks: 'will share evaluations when we roll out to developers via APIs'). Gemini 3.5 Pro mentioned as rolling out 'next month' — NOT YET RELEASED, skipped per strict-attribution.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION — all 14 Gemini 3.5 Flash scores cross-verified between deepmind.google model card + llm-stats.com blog comparison table. Three new benchmarks introduced (terminal_bench_2_1, finance_agent_v2, blueprint_bench_2) because model card explicitly labels them with version suffixes that produce different scores than the existing v1/v2 variants in DB (e.g. terminal_bench_2 gemini-3.1-pro=68.5 vs terminal_bench_2.1 gemini-3.1-pro=70.3).

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
models._note: Default model in Gemini app + Google Search AI Mode + Google Antigravity from May 19 2026. Pricing $1.50/M input / $9.00/M output / $0.15/M cached input. Output up to 64K tokens. Architecture extends Gemini 3 Flash with thinking levels (quality/cost/latency tradeoff). Outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on 10 of 14 published benchmarks; trails on MRCR-128k / HLE / ARC-AGI-2.

models.name: Gemini Omni Flash
models._note: Multimodal video+audio generation model. Inputs: text/images/audio/video. Outputs: high-resolution video with audio. Capabilities scope T2VA / I2VA / R2VA / video editing / image generation. Distributed via Gemini App / YouTube / Google Flow / Google Flow Music. No benchmark scores published yet — model card explicitly states evaluations will be released when rolled out via APIs. Speech-conversion capability deliberately restricted.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench 2.1 — agentic terminal coding benchmark, version 2.1 (revised task set vs v2.0). Gemini 3.1 Pro scores 68.5 on v2.0 vs 70.3 on v2.1, confirming v2.0/v2.1 are non-overlapping splits.

benchmarks.name: Finance Agent Benchmark v2
benchmarks.description: Finance Agent Benchmark version 2 — financial analysis tasks. Updated task set vs v1. Used by Google for Gemini 3.5 Flash launch comparison.

benchmarks.name: Blueprint-Bench 2
benchmarks.description: Blueprint-Bench v2 — image-to-floor-plan reasoning benchmark, version 2. Normalized score 0-100. Introduced as eval target in Gemini 3.5 Flash model card.

scores._section: === Gemini 3.5 Flash (deepmind.google model card, cross-confirmed by llm-stats.com) ===
scores._note: Agentic terminal coding. +5.9 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (70.3).
SWE-Bench Pro Public split, single attempt. Canonical PDF page 4 value (earlier WebFetch + llm-stats both reported 55.1, corrected via PDF read 2026-05-20).
MCP Atlas multi-step workflows. +5.4 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (78.2).
Toolathlon real-world tool use. +7.1 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (49.4).
OSWorld-Verified agentic computer use. +2.2 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (76.2).
Finance Agent v2 — biggest delta vs Gemini 3.1 Pro: +14.9 (vs 43.0).
GDPval-AA Elo rating. +342 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (1314).
Blueprint-Bench 2 normalized score. +7.1 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (26.5).
MRCR v2 8-needle 128k average. REGRESSION: -7.6 vs Gemini 3.1 Pro (84.9). Long-context recall trade-off for speed.
MRCR v2 8-needle 1M pointwise. +0.3 over Gemini 3.1 Pro (26.3) — essentially tied.
Humanity's Last Exam (text + multimodal). REGRESSION: -4.2 vs Gemini 3.1 Pro (44.4).
ARC-AGI-2 abstract reasoning. REGRESSION: -5.0 vs Gemini 3.1 Pro (77.1). Flash variant trades abstract-reasoning depth for speed.
